runtime.note: Ad hoc diagnostic logs were captured from the retained dirty QEMU worktree. They identify investigation paths but do not define a product runtime.

qio_bulk_read_diagnostic.method: For selected QIO reads, the temporary diagnostic path reads from the same m25p80 BlockBackend with blk_pread and compares the result with the subsequent byte-wise SSI data stream.

followed_by: WDT reset info: PRO CPU PC=0x0
temporary_path_result.reproduction: NOT REPRODUCED in the later stateful-SSI rebuild within a 120-second direct-read window; treat the REPL observation as runtime/window-sensitive rather than a stable milestone

qio_bulk_read_diagnostic.classification: The temporary shortcut proved the backing-store bytes agree with the modeled SSI stream and that per-byte QIO forwarding is a major diagnostic cost. The shortcut bypasses the SSI data phase and is not an acceptable product fix.
qio_bulk_read_diagnostic.next_product_step: Preserve the stateful SSI batch path and correlate flash-operation, cross-core/DPORT handoff, guest progress and watchdog feed on one virtual timeline; do not reduce the fix to a direct BlockBackend bypass.

wdt_int_ena_semantics.classification: The observed register state remains valid, but the mask-gating conclusion in patch 0035 is superseded by 0095. Legacy ESP-IDF configures WDTCONFIG0.LEVEL_INT_EN without programming INT_ENA.WDT, so the WDT level must remain independent of the masked INT_ST value. The historical two controls still reset because they were run with 0035.

crosscore_stall_diagnostic.symbol_hint: CPU0 wait path corresponds to spi_flash_op_block_func; the CPU1 samples are in the DPORT safe-read / flash-cache handoff path.
crosscore_stall_diagnostic.classification: Disabling watchdog reset removed the reset symptom, but the earlier claim of a permanent cross-core deadlock was too strong. A later direct memory-state trace observed the flash-operation can-start/complete flags and cross-core reasons toggling repeatedly. The current leading boundary is aggregate synchronous flash/cache-handoff throughput, not a proven permanent handshake deadlock.

not_claimed: the temporary bulk-read shortcut is a product implementation
disabling the watchdog is a fix
the cross-core trace proves one root cause
physical SPI flash, cache, PSRAM, timer or watchdog timing
